description: Documents the specific error scenario of API-033 (Create Bill) where billNumber already exists within the organization + branch. Same endpoint as API-033, isolated here to preserve the original docs/API_Contracts_and_Test_Results.xlsx functionality numbering.

body.billNumber: string - duplicate of an existing bill_number in this scenario

validation: billNumber must be unique within organization + branch (UNIQUE uq_bill_number)

success.status_definition: N/A - this functionality ID documents only the failure path; see API-033 for the success contract

errors.condition: billNumber already exists within organization + branch
